$comment: Small group setup and the rules that shape every small group, in every dataset. See docs/small-groups.md for the reasoning.

purpose.$comment: A Group Type Purpose value, so the calibration scripts find small groups by purpose, as they do in real churches.

host.name: Host
host.description: Opens their home for the group's meetings.

descriptions: We dig into Sunday's message together and talk about how it plays out in everyday life.
A relaxed evening of talking through the weekend sermon, with good questions and good snacks.
We read through the Gospel of John a chapter at a time. No background needed.
A slow, honest walk through John, one conversation at a time.
Couples encouraging couples. We talk honestly about building a marriage that lasts.
A group for married couples who want to grow together, with practical conversations and plenty of laughter.
Parents comparing notes, praying for our kids, and learning from each other.
From toddlers to teens, we share what is working, what is not, and where we need help.
Men studying the Bible together and keeping each other honest.
A weekly study for men who want real friendships and a deeper faith.
Twenties and thirties figuring out faith, work, and life together.
A group for young adults who want community that goes deeper than small talk.
We spend most of our time praying for each other, our church, and our city.
A small, steady group that gathers to pray and share what God is doing.
New to church or just exploring? Bring your questions; there are no wrong ones.
A welcoming place to learn the basics of faith alongside others who are new too.
A gentle group for anyone carrying a loss. Come as you are.
We walk alongside each other through grief, with hope and without hurry.
Practical conversations about budgeting, debt, and living generously.
We learn how to manage money well and give freely, together.

childCareProvided.name: Child Care Provided
childCareProvided.description: Whether the group provides child care during meetings.

meetingStyle.name: Meeting Style
meetingStyle.description: Whether the group meets in person or online.

meetingLink.name: Meeting Link
meetingLink.description: The link online groups use to meet.

participation.$comment: Cast: percent of eligible adults in an active group, by connection status. Generated households use the profile's share of active adults in a group.

testCases.$comment: Group Finder and history cases. mainCampus applies to the Cast's campus; eachOtherCampus to every other campus in the dataset.

cast.$comment: Legacy Cast small groups keep their Guids. A pin fixes a group's leader or host; groups listed in notInPattern are left alone.
